news.headline: Wall Street rout: Nasdaq -5.3%, S&P 500 -3.7% on Friday
news.what_happened: US equities sold off sharply on 20 Nov amid AI-valuation fears; Nasdaq closed at 22,618 and S&P 500 at 6,910. Nikkei fell 5.1% and Hang Seng is down ~1.3% in Asia today. US 10Y yield fell to ~4.91% as money moved to bonds and gold.
news.why_it_matters: Sharp global risk-off raises odds of a weak open and FII profit-booking after a strong November inflow run (Nifty closed Friday +1.1% at 25,800.6). Defensives and domestic-cost-driven sectors should hold up better than IT and high-beta names.

news.headline: Brent crude slides ~3.3% to ~$89.5
news.what_happened: Brent is at ~$89.5/bbl versus $92.6 on Friday; WTI ~$83.1. Move is mid-session and may change.
news.why_it_matters: A >3% crude drop cuts jet fuel and petrochemical input costs, helping airlines and paints, and eases India's import bill and inflation outlook. Negative for upstream oil.

news.headline: Rupee firms ~0.7% to ~92.66 per USD
news.what_happened: USD/INR slipped to ~92.66 from 93.29 as the dollar softened and crude fell.
news.why_it_matters: A >0.7% rupee gain is a headwind for IT and pharma exporters whose USD earnings convert to fewer rupees; combined with the Nasdaq rout, IT looks the weakest sector today.

news.headline: Gold jumps ~2% to ~$3,584 as safe-haven demand returns
news.what_happened: Gold rebounded from $3,515 on Friday as equities slid and yields fell.
news.why_it_matters: Supports gold-loan NBFC collateral values and jewellery sentiment, while signalling broad risk-off.

news.headline: Institutional flows: heavy FII buying through November
news.what_happened: FIIs were net buyers for several sessions (19 Nov provisional ~Rs 7,411 Cr, unconfirmed); 20 Nov figures not available at time of writing. DIIs have been net sellers in November.
news.why_it_matters: Strong FII inflows lifted Nifty to 8-month highs, so a global shock raises reversal risk if flows pause.

sector_outlook.reason: Defensive in risk-off; cheaper packaging inputs
Lower yields help, but FII reversal risk

picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline opex and fuel/lease costs are dollar-linked, so lower crude plus a stronger rupee directly lifts margins.
Crude derivatives are 40-50% of paint raw material cost, so a sharp crude fall improves gross margin outlook.

picks.catalyst: Global risk-off plus lower crude-linked input costs
picks.logic: Defensive FMCG leader tends to outperform when US/Asia sell off and FIIs rotate to safety; cheaper packaging and surfactant inputs add support.

risks: Global shock (Nasdaq -5.3%, Nikkei -5.1%) can trigger a gap-down and FII profit-booking after a strong rally; entries may need to wait for the open to settle.
GIFT Nifty and 20 Nov FII/DII data were unavailable; crude, rupee and HSI figures are mid-session and may change.
Watch zones are based on Friday's close; a large gap invalidates them.
eod_summary: Broad risk-off day: Nifty -1.75% to 25,349.65. All three picks closed lower (INDIGO -1.36%, ASIANPAINT -1.58%, HINDUNILVR -1.66%); 0/3 hit target, 0/3 direction correct.
